name: JellyTrends
overview: Netflix-style trending rows built from your own library
description: Adds Top N Movies and Top N Shows rows to the Jellyfin home screen, built from the titles you own. Charts come from TMDB, Trakt or the keyless Cinemeta catalog, and each title keeps its real position in the online chart. Matching runs on the server, and the rows use Jellyfin's own cards and scrollers. Requires the File Transformation plugin.
